actionable_savings_levers_summary: Escape Forvis Mazars disclaimer regime + restore unmodified audit opinion — auditor cost reduction + reputation + borrowing-cost insulation
DSG £17m cumulative deficit + statutory override expiry 31 March 2026 — Safety Valve / DBV programme entry critical; potential s.114 trigger if override ends without intervention
Pre-empt March 2026 Ofsted/CQC SEND inspection — demand-management savings via early-help reform before adverse verdict
Reserves depletion trajectory (£9.16m drawn 2024/25 on top of £5.7m 2023/24) — sustainable plan to reverse reserves drawdown is the primary fiscal lever
Children's and Adults social care packages — demand-management + commissioning review of the largest controllable spend
£6.9m savings target 2026/27 already approved — execution monitoring + transparent reporting
Property estate (~300 properties) rationalisation + pooled capital receipts policy review
